C-DOCUMENT-RUNTIME-RELIABILITY-235.Summary: Restore the operational document path on Debian and Astra Linux: a full bundle must deliver verified OCR or refuse activation, Docomator failures must remain safely diagnosable, and every browser upload must accept Unicode file names without constructing invalid HTTP headers.
C-DOCUMENT-RUNTIME-RELIABILITY-235.Problem: The published 0.4.0 code declares Tesseract, Russian and English language data, Poppler and LibreOffice in its full package profile, but the installer treats a non-mutating package failure as an acceptable degraded full deployment, does not persist the package payload beside the installed system, and runs strict checks before the repair branch can repair anything. A target can therefore activate a release without OCR and later have no local payload available for recovery. In parallel, controlled Docomator gateway failures are converted by the generic HTTP error serializer into an indistinguishable internal-server message, while browser code can pass an idempotency key containing a raw Cyrillic file name into the native Headers constructor before the existing fetch wrapper normalizes it.

Goals.Goal: Make the full offline profile fail closed before application staging or current-switch when its exact target package layer cannot provide Tesseract, rus and eng language data, Poppler, LibreOffice and a real OCR smoke result.
Persist a verified immutable copy of the target package payload in an installer-owned local cache so a later root repair can use it without Internet access or an original removable medium.

Reorder repair diagnostics so missing document capabilities can actually be repaired before strict acceptance is evaluated, while preserving additive-only APT, no automatic fix-broken and rollback safety.
Classify DNS, refused connection, timeout, TLS, wrong-service, not-ready, access and protocol failures from Docomator and expose only predetermined safe operational messages to the administrator.

Introduce one synchronous deterministic UTF-8 SHA-256 normalization path for idempotency header values before any native Headers construction, while preserving the original Unicode document name and immutable source metadata.
Prove desktop and mobile behavior, keyboard/focus continuity, repeated uploads, offline installation and exact-target rejection without adding runtime dependencies or a schema migration.

Constraints.Constraint: The verified base is main commit e5367b5423a9b14b1b81c8083ff1e96aee793f03 with tree 4c3b27197b15813bc7ff11b8e4e380c0c5b389a5.
Issue 235 is the authoritative user scenario and acceptance record; issue 234 is the operational repair umbrella.
Only one active GRACE change may exist. Plan and meeting corrections in issues 236 and 237 remain queued until this change is merged, post-merge verified and archived as applied.
No applied migration is edited and no new migration is introduced by this change.
Full-bundle strictness must not make OCR, LibreOffice, Docomator, Internet or an LLM mandatory for development, runtime-only bundles or the deterministic calendar and task core.
An Astra package payload must be produced on a matching Astra reference series and architecture. A Debian package closure must never be represented as an Astra artifact.
APT operations remain additive-only: no package version pinning on target, downgrade, upgrade of an installed package, removal, allow-downgrades or automatic fix-broken.
Raw network causes, stack traces, cookies, access codes and remote response bodies are not public error details.
The original file name, document bytes, SHA-256, document version and evidence locators remain unchanged; only the transport idempotency identity is canonicalized.
No new npm, Python or system runtime dependency may be added beyond the document packages already declared in the target package profile.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Publish or overwrite a release asset from this implementation PR.
Build Astra packages on GitHub-hosted Debian runners or claim Astra acceptance without a matching reference target.
Scan the local network or probe alternative Docomator ports automatically.
Make Docomator required for local staff management.
Change plan filtering, reversible plan-row decisions, meeting identity or meeting-template repetition; those are governed by issues 236 and 237.
Physically remove a source document or rewrite its provenance.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: A full target bundle whose package step cannot produce an additive-only compatible plan exits before staging a new release, changing current, migrating SQLite or stopping the previously working application for an extended operation.
A successful full installation records a verified immutable package payload in the installer cache and the cache can be reused idempotently by doctor repair without the original bundle.
The normal full-profile doctor requires Tesseract, requested rus and eng languages, pdftoppm, pdftotext, LibreOffice, a real Tesseract TSV smoke and a Poppler PDF-render smoke.
Repair evaluates package health and installs missing capabilities before executing strict doctor; an unrepaired state returns non-zero and never reports the system as fully ready.
Package cache writes are atomic, profile checked, checksum verified and never mutate an existing payload with a different manifest.

Docomator DNS, refused connection, timeout, TLS, wrong-service and not-ready failures have distinct stable codes and concise Russian messages, while unknown 5xx errors remain masked as an internal server error.
The access code is not persisted or echoed, and public 5xx error responses omit low-level details even for safely classified operational errors.
The UI keeps host, protocol, port and current access-code input available after a failed check, renders an inline status rather than a modal, and remains usable by keyboard on desktop and mobile.
Every raw idempotency header value is converted synchronously to a bounded ASCII kp-v1 SHA-256 identity before a native Headers constructor sees it; a value already in canonical form is stable.

Cyrillic, mixed-script, emoji and long file names reach the upload request without a ByteString exception, and repeating the same input produces the same idempotency value without changing the preserved source name.
Focused unit, integration, shell syntax, Python compilation, Playwright desktop/mobile, systemd full-offline, backup and project regression gates pass on one exact head.

GRACE final, project CI, release gate, database gate, browser gate and full-offline gate are successful before exact-head squash merge; post-merge CI is successful before the separate archive-only terminal transition.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedCommand: node --test tests/http-headers.test.mjs tests/http-utils.test.mjs tests/docomator-integration.test.mjs tests/offline-package-policy.test.mjs tests/deploy-install-contract.test.mjs tests/deployment-flow.test.mjs
VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: The exact branch head shows strict full-profile activation, an immutable repair payload, real document smoke checks, safe classified integration errors and Unicode-safe requests while the deterministic core remains independent of all optional integrations.

Assumptions.Assumption: The current target screenshot is consistent with the existing degraded full-install branch: Tesseract is absent, rus and eng are missing and doctor reports command_not_found while API and worker remain active.
The 0.4.0 GitHub release contains a Debian 12 amd64 package closure; it is not a matching Astra package asset.
The existing outer transaction installer can restore the previous current, services, config and backup when the inner installer exits non-zero.
The existing immutable document store already preserves Unicode source names and hashes independently from the transport idempotency key.
